title: EvidenceCapabilityReceipt
description: Canonical evidence-capability receipt (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §7.10: a reusable, consumer-independent observation evaluated by Sage acceptance, Arcane proof, and Oracle controls without transferring authority; the source archive used the superseded name Seer). Distinct from the existing legion schemas/controls/evidence-capability-v1.schema.json, which models capability *availability* (id/available/owner/reason); this object models the *observation itself*, produced after execution, and is dependency-bound per ARCHITECTURE §34 (evidence goes stale when a decision it depends on changes).

capability.description: What was observed, e.g. 'test-run', 'diagnostic-probe', 'lint-check', 'reproduction'. Free string by design; not a closed enum in source docs.

observation.description: Producer-specific structured observation payload (command/exit-code/artifact refs, or a structural finding). Deliberately opaque here: the shape varies per capability and is not specified by ARCHITECTURE/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN beyond 'reusable, consumer-independent'.

evidenceClass.description: Values match the existing legion EVIDENCE_CLASS convention (lib/contracts, providers/security/contracts.mjs) by deliberate alignment, duplicated inline rather than imported to avoid a runtime dependency from this package on legion's internal provider pipeline. Judgment call, see FREEZE.md J-5.

authentication.description: Same shape and rationale as legion-effect-receipt-v1's authentication field (S00 Forge baseline finding: no receipt in the legacy system carries real authentication, only a self-hash).

replayDefense.description: Same shape and rationale as legion-effect-receipt-v1's replayDefense field (S00 Forge baseline finding: no nonce/sequence/freshness field exists anywhere in legacy Forge records).

dependsOn.description: ARCHITECTURE §34: dependency-aware invalidation. When any dependsOn entry changes, this receipt becomes stale.

consumers.description: IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §7.10: which of the three consumer classes may evaluate this receipt.
